Product Description

Empowered PC Sentinel AMD Threadripper Workstation

Experience rapid workflow acceleration with Empowered PC's Sentinel AMD Threadripper Workstion. The Sentinel Threadripper workstations come with AMD Ryzen Threadripper Pro 7000 Series processor, delivering unparalleled compute power for multi-threaded applications with up to 96 cores.

Advance Your Business

SENTINEL THREADRIPPER WORKSTATION

Introducing the forefront of AMD Ryzen Threadripper PRO-powered workstations. The Empowered PC Sentinel Threadripper Workstation effortlessly handles intensive workflows and cutting-edge applications like AR/VR, Generative AI for content creation and code generation, and for AI modeling, and data science. Featuring advanced cooling, storage, and memory, the Sentinel Workstation undergoes rigorous stress testing to deliver maximum uptime, making it perfect for mission-critical environments.

    • Massive memory capacity and bandwidth for large datasets

    • AMD PRO security helps keep sensitive data secure

  3. Sentinel Workstation with 7000 WX-Series Benefits

    • Full spectrum performance
    • Seamless 3D modeling and design experience
    • Rapidly visualize alternate design ideas

    • AMD PRO technologies to help with data security

Next page

The Performance You Demand, Right When You Need It Experience high performance & ergonomic design with the Sentinel Workstation. Effortlessly customizable and upgradeable, its CPU cores and memory scale to meet your workload demands, with various power supply and storage capacity options available.

Sentinel AMD Threadripper Workstation

ACCELERATE YOUR CREATIVE VISION


The Empowered PC Sentinel Workstation, powered by AMD Ryzen Threadripper PRO processors, offers battle-tested performance and capabilities, empowering artists, architects, and engineers to achieve more in less time.

WHY BUY FROM EMPOWERED PC?

Maximized Performance

Empowered PCs are expertly crafted to maximize your budget to have the best performance for gaming and accelerating creative work.

Extended Support

Empowered PC desktops are backed by our lifetime technical and diagnostic support, ensuring your PC stays in top-notch condition for years.

Assembled in the USA

All our PCs are built by PC experts and PC enthusiasts here in the USA. We provide jobs to Americans and deliver the best quality systems possible.

Robust QC Process

Each PC undergoes rigorous stress testing using premium software designed to tax every component at 100% ensuring your PC plays right out of the box.

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.
